notes.title: Version 1.2.2: Improved graphics, fixed level
notes.notes: Final update (for today), I promise. :). Now everything should work as intended.

notes.title: Hotfix -- Missing Stones
notes.notes:
Whoops... Anyone missing any stones?! I added a couple -- so a previously impossible level is now solvable again (I won't tell you which one, though :)). 

Sorry about that and happy solving!

notes.title: MagnetoBotty V1.2.0 - Small Update
notes.notes:
Hey MagnetoBotty players,

after three years, it was finally time for another (albeit small) update.
In the current version, I changed the graphics a little and switched to different renderers, mostly in preparation for a [b]level editor feature[/b] that is due --- at some point... (But not yet).

In addition to that, I fixed some bugs:
[list]
[*] Music volume is turned down when the tutorial speech plays
[*] Privacy Policy link was (temporarily) broken
[*] Some menu items could not be selected with keyboard controls
[/list]

and I also implemented a new help button (which can be removed from the screen), which will display the objective of each level.

=> Have fun playing!!
